WIRE-01.observed: useHealth is called in page.tsx and DashboardView.tsx, but not centrally in layout.tsx or AppShell.tsx.
WIRE-01.expected: useHealth should be invoked from the root layout or AppShell so it warms up the backend on any page load.
WIRE-01.fix_direction: Import and call useHealth() in AppShell.tsx so the health check runs regardless of entry route.

WIRE-02.description: Connecting spinner is rendered in layout while awaiting 200
WIRE-02.observed: A text badge is shown on Landing page and a spinner in Dashboard, but the layout/shell itself doesn't show a global connecting spinner.
WIRE-02.expected: The layout/shell should consume the health loading state and display a global spinner or overlay during cold start.
WIRE-02.fix_direction: Consume useHealth() status in AppShell.tsx and render a blocking overlay or banner with a spinner when status is 'connecting'.

WIRE-03.observed: The status transitions to 'healthy' and loading UI elements are removed.
WIRE-03.expected: Spinner should unmount when status is healthy.

WIRE-04.observed: useHealth sets isDemoMode to true after 3 retries, but does not fetch demo-fallback.json.
WIRE-04.expected: demo-fallback.json should be fetched and its data made available globally when health check fails.
WIRE-04.fix_direction: Add fetch('/demo-fallback.json') in the failure block of check() in useHealth.ts and store the result in the hook's state.

WIRE-05.description: POST /api/v1/documents/ hook passes X-GDPR-Consent header at call site
WIRE-05.observed: X-GDPR-Consent is hardcoded in api-generated/index.ts and not passed explicitly from the useUploadState hook.
WIRE-05.expected: useUploadState should pass the GDPR consent header explicitly to the typed client.
WIRE-05.fix_direction: Update uploadDocument signature in index.ts to accept a headers object, and pass { 'X-GDPR-Consent': 'demo' } from useUploadState.ts.

WIRE-06.description: POST /api/v1/translate/ hook passes X-GDPR-Consent header at call site
WIRE-06.observed: X-GDPR-Consent is baked into the typed client and not passed explicitly from the useTranslationState hook.
WIRE-06.expected: useTranslationState should pass the GDPR consent header explicitly to the typed client.
WIRE-06.fix_direction: Update translateDocument signature in index.ts to accept headers, and pass { 'X-GDPR-Consent': 'demo' } from useTranslationState.ts.

WIRE-07.observed: useSearchSSE.ts constructs the URL using string interpolation with gdpr_consent=demo.
WIRE-07.expected: URL should contain gdpr_consent=demo as a query parameter.

WIRE-08.description: GET /api/v1/health/ does NOT send GDPR header
WIRE-08.observed: The health check fetch does not include the GDPR header.
WIRE-08.expected: Health endpoint should not receive GDPR consent header.

WIRE-09.description: POST /api/v1/documents/ uses multipart/form-data with file and target_lang
WIRE-09.observed: uploadDocument in index.ts correctly constructs a FormData object with file and target_lang.
WIRE-09.expected: Request should use FormData with file and target_lang fields.

WIRE-10.description: Upload response matches expected shape in typed client
WIRE-10.observed: UploadResponse interface defines pages with text and confidence.
WIRE-10.expected: Response type should match API contract for UploadResponse.

WIRE-11.description: pages[].text is rendered in the success state
WIRE-11.observed: UploadView.tsx renders page.text in a table cell.
WIRE-11.expected: Extracted text should be visible in success component.

WIRE-12.observed: UploadView.tsx renders page.confidence as a percentage in the table.
WIRE-12.expected: Confidence scores should be visible per page.

WIRE-13.description: Loading state shown during upload request
WIRE-13.observed: useUploadState sets status='loading', which UploadView uses to display a Spinner.
WIRE-13.expected: Loading UI should be displayed while upload is pending.

WIRE-14.description: Error state shown with recovery action on upload fail
WIRE-14.observed: UploadView handles status='error' by showing the error message and a Try Again button.
WIRE-14.expected: Failed uploads should render an error message and retry button.

WIRE-15.description: POST /api/v1/translate/ with JSON, pages[], and GDPR header
WIRE-15.observed: translateDocument sends application/json, pages array, and includes GDPR header.
WIRE-15.expected: Request should be properly formatted JSON with pages and consent header.

WIRE-16.expected: Response type should match expected translation shape.

WIRE-17.description: translated_pages[].text is rendered in success state
WIRE-17.observed: TranslationView renders page.text in the translated panel.

WIRE-18.description: Truncation banner styled and raw string removed from body text
WIRE-18.observed: TranslationView renders the truncation banner, but page.text still contains the raw '[truncated for demo]' string.
WIRE-18.expected: The '[truncated for demo]' marker should be stripped from the body text before rendering.
WIRE-18.fix_direction: In TranslationView.tsx, render `page.text.replace('[truncated for demo]', '')` instead of the raw `page.text`.

WIRE-19.observed: useTranslationState provides loading status, and TranslationView renders a Spinner.
WIRE-19.expected: Loading UI should be displayed while translation is pending.

WIRE-20.description: Error state with recovery action for translation
WIRE-20.observed: TranslationView renders error message and a Try Again button.
WIRE-20.expected: Errors should display human-readable text and a retry option.

WIRE-21.description: EventSource URL contains q and gdpr_consent params
WIRE-21.observed: URL is built correctly in useSearchSSE.ts.
WIRE-21.expected: Both query parameters should be present.

WIRE-22.description: result event appends to state incrementally
WIRE-22.observed: es.addEventListener('result') parses JSON and appends to results array.
WIRE-22.expected: Results should stream in and update state incrementally.

WIRE-23.description: Keepalive ping supported via native EventSource
WIRE-23.observed: Hook uses the browser native EventSource which handles : ping natively.
WIRE-23.expected: Should use EventSource instead of manually parsing ReadableStream.

WIRE-24.description: done event calls es.close() and sets done flag
WIRE-24.observed: done listener calls closeConnection() and updates status.
WIRE-24.expected: Should gracefully close the stream on done event.

WIRE-25.description: error SSE event calls close() and retries
WIRE-25.observed: error listener closes connection and triggers startSearch with backoff.
WIRE-25.expected: Application errors should be handled with a full query retry.

WIRE-26.description: es.onerror implements max 3 retries with backoff
WIRE-26.observed: onerror handler implements a 3-attempt retry loop with 2s/4s/8s delays.
WIRE-26.expected: Network errors should trigger exponential backoff retries.

WIRE-27.description: Hook does not buffer results, renders immediately
WIRE-27.observed: setResults with functional update is called per result event, triggering immediate render.
WIRE-27.expected: No intermediate buffering should delay rendering.

WIRE-28.description: Generated client exists and is non-empty
WIRE-28.observed: frontend/src/lib/api-generated/index.ts is populated with interfaces and fetch methods.

WIRE-29.observed: TranslateRequest and upload parameters match the specified shapes.
WIRE-29.expected: Requests should align with backend expectations.

WIRE-30.description: Response shapes and SSE events match api-contracts.md
WIRE-30.observed: SSE events (result, done, error) are not typed in index.ts, and SSEResult in useSearchSSE.ts lacks 'sequence' or 'citation' types.
WIRE-30.expected: Search event types should be fully typed in the generated client matching the contract.
WIRE-30.fix_direction: Move SSE event types into index.ts, ensuring they match the contract (e.g. data payload wrapping, sequence field).

WIRE-31.description: Hooks import from generated client entirely
WIRE-31.observed: useHealth.ts uses a raw fetch instead of calling checkHealth() from index.ts.
WIRE-31.expected: No hooks should use raw fetch to call the backend APIs.
WIRE-31.fix_direction: Import and use checkHealth() from @/lib/api-generated in useHealth.ts.

WIRE-32.description: demo-fallback.json exists and is valid JSON
WIRE-32.observed: demo-fallback.json is present and parses successfully.
WIRE-32.expected: Fallback file must be valid JSON.

WIRE-33.description: Fallback JSON shape matches typed client response shapes
WIRE-33.observed: demo-fallback.json uses generic keys ('document', 'upload') which completely mismatch the UploadResponse and TranslateResponse interfaces in index.ts.
WIRE-33.expected: The fallback JSON must have exact matches to the expected API response shapes.
WIRE-33.fix_direction: Refactor demo-fallback.json to match the exact keys from UploadResponse, TranslateResponse, etc., from api-generated/index.ts.

WIRE-34.description: Health failure loads demo-fallback.json and pipes it to components
WIRE-34.observed: demo-fallback.json is completely unused by the app. useHealth sets a demo mode flag but never fetches the fallback JSON.
WIRE-34.expected: The app should fetch and utilize demo-fallback.json when the API is offline.
WIRE-34.fix_direction: Fetch demo-fallback.json upon health check failure and expose it via context to hydrate components.

WIRE-35.description: Demo mode banner exists and uses tokens
WIRE-35.observed: DashboardView and HeroSection render demo banners using stitch tokens.
WIRE-35.expected: A styled offline banner should be present.

WIRE-36.description: Matrix login inputs are controlled via hook state
WIRE-36.observed: MatrixLoginModal uses uncontrolled inputs (no value/onChange), and useMatrixLoginState manages no form state.
WIRE-36.expected: The hook should track email and password, and the inputs should be controlled.
WIRE-36.fix_direction: Add email and password state to useMatrixLoginState, and wire them to value and onChange in MatrixLoginModal.

WIRE-37.observed: onSuccess only calls login() and onClose(), but does not push the user to /dashboard.
WIRE-37.expected: Should route the user to the dashboard or logged-in root after success.
WIRE-37.fix_direction: Import useRouter from next/navigation and call router.push('/dashboard') in the onSuccess callback.

WIRE-38.description: Failed matrix login sets human-readable error
WIRE-38.observed: If error occurs, it is stored in state and rendered plainly.
WIRE-38.expected: Errors should be readable and not expose raw JSON.

WIRE-39.observed: The modal has max-width: 400px and width: 100%, allowing it to shrink appropriately.
